title: What is added?
source: 本文的核心贡献是把靶RNA识别、蛋白酶切割与gasdermin介导的焦亡串成一个可编程回路。
english: A programmable circuit couples RNA recognition, protease activity and gasdermin-mediated cell death.

title: What distinguishes the historical context?
source: 它们与DAMAGE共享“RNA输入—可编程输出”思想，但输出机制和细胞死亡终点不同。
english: Earlier circuits share RNA-input logic; DAMAGE differs in its output mechanism and cell-death endpoint.

title: How far does selectivity extend?
source: 这些结果支持“在已测试模型中具有靶RNA依赖的选择性”，不能外推为对所有细胞或所有异常转录组均具同等选择性。
english: Target-RNA-dependent selectivity is supported in tested models; equal selectivity across all cells is not established.

title: What remains to be demonstrated?
source: 但论文对体内治疗使用的是潜在性表述，而非体内疗效、安全性或组织选择性的验证。
english: In vivo treatment remains a potential application; efficacy, safety and tissue selectivity were not validated.
